task.description: Implement transactional use case for storing packages with allocation policy.
task.rationale: Core business operation: delivery agent stores package, system allocates locker, generates pickup code.
acceptanceCriteria: Use case accepts package reference and size
Allocation policy selects smallest suitable available locker
Deterministic selection when multiple lockers same size
Transactional: package, assignment, and locker status updated atomically
Returns plaintext pickup code exactly once
task.implementationNotes: Created PackageRepository and StorageAssignmentRepository ports. Implemented StorePackageUseCase with allocation policy (smallest suitable locker), idempotent duplicate handling, pickup code generation, and comprehensive unit tests. Use case validates locker availability before storage and returns plaintext pickup code exactly once.
task.testEvidence: Unit tests cover: successful storage flow, pickup code generation, package and assignment persistence, duplicate reference handling (idempotent), already stored package error, no suitable locker scenarios, race condition handling, allocation policy verification. Total: 12 test cases.
